text:
maria (AE): Borealis wants an acceptance matrix and a short perf run this week: sustain 120 qps p99 <350ms, support 3x 2m bursts to 800 qps, KMS in-path. Can we do Thu?

sam (SE): Yes. Plan: 30m soak @120 qps, then 3 microbursts (2m) to 800 qps spaced 5m. Compare fp32 baseline vs 4-bit quant + KV cache. Capture p50/p95/p99, GPU util, host queueing, and kernel-fallback counts.

zoe (ops): I can provision a temp dedicated pool (4xA100 + standby). Batching target=16, conservative concurrency. I'll open loadgen IP and enable metrics.

deploy-bot: provision: pool-borealis-5429 started, ETA ~10m.

sam (SE): Quick reproducible commands I'll include in the runbook: hey -z 30m -q 120 -c 250 POST /v1/generate ; then 3x hey -z 2m -q 800 -c 1000 POST /v1/generate spaced by 5m. Will collect nvidia-smi samples and proxy traces.

raj (SRE): Flag: KMS decrypts have caused tail spikes before. Short-term mitigations: pre-warm tokens and increase proxy worker threads. Long-term: async decrypt off the hot path or HSM-backed flow.

sam (SE): Post-run TL;DR (quick snapshot): fp32 p99 = 285ms (no KMS). With KMS p99 steady ~330ms with some spikes. Quantized steady p99 ~480ms; during 800 qps microbursts quant p99 peaked ~620ms due to kernel fallback and queueing. GPU util ~70% soak -> ~95% peak.

maria (AE): Sales wants a small cost note: monthly Dedicated estimate + prorated test, and hosted-burst per-peak-qps-minute. Sam/zoe please draft numbers and attach to runbook.

zoe (ops): I'll post cost bullets after I finalize infra. Blockers from their security team: HSM requirement, key custody flow, and retention windows.

raj (SRE): I'll draft security answers and a canary recipe (5% -> 25% -> 100% with automated rollback if p99 > 500ms for 10m).

maria (AE): Great. Next: sam uploads 1-pg runbook + CSV/plots, zoe posts cost prorate, raj posts security draft. I'll schedule customer follow-up Friday 11am PT.
